about.title: Digital solutions that serve organisations
about.intro: TSD Systems designs and sells digital solutions for schools, businesses and agricultural value chains.
about.mission1: Give organisations simple, reliable tools to run their day-to-day activity: less paper, fewer scattered files, up-to-date and shared information.
about.mission2: Our solutions are built for teams with little time to spend on IT: they must be clear from the very first use.

clarity.title: Clarity
clarity.text: Readable screens, plain words, explanations everyone can understand.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.text: Tools you can count on every day, with data handled with care.

listening.title: Listening
listening.text: The needs expressed by users guide how each solution evolves.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.text: Clear commitments and a direct relationship with the founders.

about.nameText: The name TSD Systems comes from the initials of its three founders: Tandjigora, Sanogo and Diallo.

team.title: The founders
